snippet.title: The Night Crawler - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Night Crawler is a tiny cozy game where you will discover the Magic of Nocturnal Insects! 🪲

Build your terrarium, collect insects, and care for them. Follow quests, earn coins, and unlock new species!

You can upgrade your gear for easier hunts. Enjoy lots of fun Steam achievements—no grinding! 

Play at your own pace: adjust time and light settings. Relax and finish the game in one sitting—just a mouse is all you need!

Wishlist on STeam :  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3893470/The_Night_Crawler?utm_source=youtube
